bio_en: Gabriel Hatsagortsian was born in Aygestan, Van, in 1890 and joined the ARF as a youth, remaining a disciplined and self-sacrificing member until his death. During the 1915 defence of Van he held his post for thirty days against the enemy's fiercest attacks. He showed the same courage in the February 1921 uprising against the Bolsheviks. He was killed by a bullet to the forehead during an advance in that uprising.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
